combos.name: Basic Trade
combos.description: Use E to reposition Q sweetspots. Hit all 3 Qs for maximum damage.

combos.name: All-in
combos.keys: R → Q1 → E → Q2 → W → Q3 → AA
combos.description: Pop R first for bonus AD. Use W between Q2 and Q3 to guarantee Q3 hit.

combos.name: Flash Combo
combos.description: Flash during Q3 animation to surprise enemies with knockup.

powerSpikes.description: R makes you nearly unkillable in all-ins

tips: Always try to hit Q sweetspots (edges) for bonus damage + knockup
Use E to extend Q range or reposition mid-Q
W is great for setting up ganks - pull enemies toward your jungler
R resets on takedowns - use it to dive backline in teamfights
Build anti-heal counter: Spirit Visage for +healing, or just outplay
Aatrox.lanePhase: Look to trade with Q1-E-Q2 when enemy goes for CS. Save Q3 for disengage or all-in. Your level 2 and 6 are very strong - look for kills.
Aatrox.teamfighting: Flank or dive backline with R active. Your job is to disrupt and drain tank. Hit as many people with Q sweetspots as possible.
Aatrox.skillOrder: Q → E → W (Q max, then E, W last)

combos.name: Poke
combos.description: Use rockets for safe poke, W to slow for more autos.

combos.name: All-in
combos.description: Drop traps, slow with W, then melt with minigun attack speed.

combos.name: Snipe
combos.description: Ult travels faster the further it goes. Lead your target.

powerSpikes.description: W + E gives kill threat with aggressive support
IE + Zeal item = you carry teamfights
You're now the strongest champ in the game

tips: Use minigun for DPS, rockets for poke/waveclear/teamfights
Place E (traps) in choke points or under CC'd enemies
Your passive lets you chase down kills - get one reset and go crazy
R does more damage at longer range - use it to snipe low HP enemies
In teamfights, stay back and use rockets. Switch to minigun when safe
Jinx.lanePhase: Farm safely with rockets, poke when possible. Your level 2 is decent with aggressive support. Focus on CS - you outscale almost everyone.
Jinx.teamfighting: Stay max range with rockets. Wait for cooldowns to be used before stepping up. Once you get a kill, passive activates - chase and clean up.
Jinx.skillOrder: Q → W → E (Q max, then W)

combos.name: Basic Gank
combos.description: Land Q, follow up, slow with E, proc passive twice.

combos.name: Insec (Basic)
combos.description: Q to target, ward behind them, W to ward, R them into team.

combos.name: Insec (Flash)
combos.description: Q in, R immediately, Flash behind to redirect kick.

combos.name: Chinese Insec
combos.description: Faster insec - W to ward first, then Q while kicking.

powerSpikes.description: R enables insec plays and executes
Your prime time - make plays happen

tips: Always weave 2 autos between abilities for passive energy restore + damage
Ward hop (W to ward) is essential - practice it
Q reveals targets - use it to check bushes
E reveals invisible units (Akali shroud, Shaco, etc)
You MUST get ahead early - if even at 20 min, you're behind
LeeSin.junglePath: Red → Krugs → Raptors → Gank or Blue → Gromp → Wolves → Gank. Lee wants to gank at level 3.
LeeSin.teamfighting: Look for insec on priority target. If behind, peel for carries with R.

tips: She parries your Q3 - bait it out or use Q1/Q2 only
Don't fight her in long trades - she wins with vitals
Bramble Vest is essential
You outscale in teamfights - don't need to win lane
Fiora.earlyGame: Respect her level 1. Trade with Q1-E-Q2 but don't commit to Q3.
Fiora.keyTiming: Bait her W before using Q3 or R

tips: You sustain through his poke
He can't stop your healing
All-in him level 6
Be careful of his jungler - he sets up ganks well
Malphite.earlyGame: Free lane. Sustain through his Q poke and look for kills.
Malphite.keyTiming: Your level 6 all-in is much stronger than his

tips: Don't fight in your minion wave - she stacks passive
If she misses E, you win the trade
Your Q sweetspots interrupt her Q dashes
Respect her 5-stack passive
Irelia.earlyGame: Don't fight level 1-2. At 3+, fight outside your wave.
Irelia.keyTiming: Fight when her passive is down

tips: He wins every early trade - don't fight
Farm with rockets from max range
If he drops axes, you can trade back
Outscale him - just survive to 2 items
Draven.earlyGame: Give up CS if needed. Don't die. You outscale hard.

tips: She outranges you early
Don't step on traps
You outscale her significantly
All-in at level 6 with aggressive support can work
Caitlyn.earlyGame: Farm under tower if needed. Avoid trap zones.

freeze.name: Freezing
freeze.description: Keep the wave just outside your tower range
freeze.howTo: Only last hit. Let 3-4 enemy minions survive each wave.
freeze.when: When ahead and want to deny CS, or when behind and need safety
tips: Tank minion aggro briefly to keep wave in place
Trim wave if it gets too big

slowPush.name: Slow Push
slowPush.description: Build a large wave that crashes into enemy tower
slowPush.howTo: Kill caster minions only for 2-3 waves
slowPush.when: Before roaming, before objectives, before backing
tips: 3-wave crash is ideal for dives
Creates 30-40 second window to roam

fastPush.name: Fast Push
fastPush.description: Quickly clear wave to crash into tower
fastPush.howTo: Use all abilities to kill wave ASAP
fastPush.when: After a kill, before objectives, to reset wave state
tips: Denies CS under tower
Creates tempo advantage

csing: Did I miss CS due to bad trading?
Did I lose CS to tower when I could have thinned wave?
Did I recognize free farm windows (enemy backed/roamed)?
trading: Did I trade when enemy used cooldowns?
Did I respect enemy power spikes?
Did I track enemy summoner spells?
vision: Did I ward before objectives spawn?
Did I die to ganks I should have seen coming?
macro: Did I rotate to help teammates?
Did I push side waves before teamfights?
teamfighting: Did I position correctly for my role?
Did I focus the right target?
Did I use abilities at the right time?
Did I track key enemy cooldowns (Flash, Zhonya, etc)?

exercises.name: No Abilities CS
exercises.goal: Get 100 CS by 12:00 using only auto attacks

exercises.name: Harass + CS
exercises.goal: 80+ CS by 10:00 while trading with bot

exercises.name: Basic Combo
exercises.goal: Execute champion's basic combo 10x in a row

exercises.name: Flash Combo
exercises.goal: Land flash combo on moving target

exercises.name: Kiting
exercises.goal: Kite dummy while moving, never stop moving

exercises.name: Animation Cancel
exercises.goal: Cancel ability animations for faster combos
